title: IBRO World Congress Travel Grants
level: PhD students and early-career postdoctoral fellows
about: IBRO World Congress Travel Grants support attendance at the IBRO 2027 World Congress in Cape Town, South Africa, from 13 to 16 September 2027. Applications open on 11 January 2027 and close on 15 March 2027.
requirements: PhD neuroscience students and early-career postdoctoral fellows (maximum 5 years from the start of the postdoc)
Must have submitted an abstract to the Congress as first author; a valid abstract ID is required
card_alt: Card for "IBRO World Congress Travel Grants" by International Brain Research Organization (IBRO), for the congress in Cape Town, South Africa; application deadline 15 Mar 2027. The photo shows elephant statues in front of the Palace of the Lost City, a resort at Sun City, South Africa, not Cape Town.
